info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve channel-specific information related to ATM network management, identified by a unique parameter. It is designed for financial institutions and service providers who need to access detailed channel data for operational purposes. The primary resource is the ATM network details, and the operation supports enhanced decision-making and analytics. Use cases include optimizing ATM networks, managing service levels, and facilitating regulatory compliance.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of ATM network management for a specific resource identified by its ID. It provides information necessary for network management and operational oversight.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to retrieve information specific to the ATM network management operation identified by RES-100045. It should be formatted as JSON and include relevant data as defined in the schema.
